scripts.dev: node scripts/env-init.mjs --if-missing && node scripts/infra.mjs up && concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @aphia/web dev" "pnpm --filter @aphia/api dev"
scripts.dev:asgi: node scripts/env-init.mjs --if-missing && node scripts/infra.mjs up && concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @aphia/web dev" "pnpm --filter @aphia/api dev:asgi"
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/run.mjs uv run --project apps/api python database/scripts/migrate.py
scripts.db:status: node scripts/run.mjs uv run --project apps/api python database/scripts/migrate.py --status
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/run.mjs uv run --project apps/api python database/scripts/seed.py
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/env-init.mjs --if-missing && node scripts/infra.mjs up && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed && playwright test
